about_the_game:
Sorting Game is a race-against-the-clock roguelike package sorter, where you must locate packages and sort them into their dedicated zones to increase your score and meet your quota. Use various game-changing upgrades to make each playthrough unique! Take on the role of a human trapped in a digital simulation, and find a way out of the Sorting Game as you progress deeper into the world, using upgrades and items to assist your progress.

STORY

A desperate contract deal has user Harvey trapped in the Sorting Game, a virtual realm emulating a dead-end warehouse job. 89 years later, a new user enters the game and assists with Harvey's escape to reality. However, returning to the real world may not be such a great idea.

GAMEPLAY

An endless world of work awaits you! Navigate through randomly selected warehouses to sort as many packages into their dedicated zones as you can while also meeting quota. The more packages you sort, the more money you earn! Spend your cash on unique upgrades to change each playthrough of Sorting Game, some affecting player stats, others affecting the whole level! Approach levels with your own strategies to utilise your most effective sorting efforts.

LEVEL EDITOR

Create your own levels using the in-game Level Editor! Manipulate level geometry with ease and create playable warehouses within minutes! (Official levels will also be developed using this tool, meaning the level editor will continue to grow as the full game is being developed.)

SPLIT-SCREEN CO-OP

Need a helping hand? Split-screen co-op mode allows you to play Sorting Game with an additional player. Work together to complete levels and escape the Sorting Game together!
